query: SELECT t.pid, t.assignee_ref AS "assignee_ref!" FROM tickets t WHERE t.first_response_breached = TRUE AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status IN ('open', 'pending', 'resolved') AND t.assignee_ref IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notifications n WHERE n.kind = 'sla_breach' AND n.source_pid = t.pid AND n.recipient_ref = t.assignee_ref AND n.source_key = 'first_response') ORDER BY t.id LIMIT $1
